Table 4 Aspects of a high-quality learning analytics dashboard (Matcha, 
et al., 2020) 
Recommendation Reasoning 
Based on a theory The paper highlights the lack of alignment with 
learning theories with existing solutions, and hints 
at the importance of grounding the design on a 
known working learning theory. 
Self-regulated learning 
support 
LADs should support many learning strategies, 
enabling students to plan, monitor and adjust their 
approaches to learning. 
Actionable feedback The paper highlights the importance that feedback 
is actionable and can guide students to improve 
their learning outcomes. This would typically 
require data to be easily interpretable, such as a 
topic being highlighted as a weak point.
